claim_boundary: Forty-four observed post-2022 international women's wheelchair-foil direct-elimination bouts, balanced 22/22 across functional categories A and B. The SAV contains bout-level temporal and sequence aggregates, not source videos, touches, athlete identities, or one row per unique athlete. Repeated-athlete overlap cannot be audited, so these rows support descriptive analysis but not a leakage-safe bout-level train/test benchmark. Undocumented variable codes remain source codes.
repository_policy: privacy-minimized CC BY row table local; code and aggregates public
